arm.doc: The laser arm: a horizontal aluminium plate from the Z carriage forward over the board, carrying the galvo head

carriage.doc: The Z carriage: an aluminium plate bolted to the two guide blocks on the column's rail; the laser arm hangs off its

carrier.doc: The line's board carrier: one per board, carried by hand from station to station and located at each the same

nest.doc: A station's nest: the plate every station (laser, paste, LumenPnP) carries, that the carrier drops onto by hand.

nut_block.doc: Holds the Z lead nut behind the carriage, beside the column, so the screw runs clear of the column and the rail.

screw_support.doc: The lead screw's bottom support: a block on the back beam with a bearing bore (a 12 mm bearing, drawn as the bore

top_plate.doc: Caps the column and carries the Z stepper over the lead screw; the coupler passes through its hole. Frame: its

rows.measured: tightest 0.005 mm between block_lower and rail at z = -80.0 mm (189 moving pairs)
rows.limit: no overlap, and every declared clearance held
rows.source: 7 poses across -80.0 to +100.0 mm. Axes are swept one at a time from home, so a crash needing two axes off-home is not covered.

rows.subject: axis z
rows.measured: travel 180.0 mm, but no work span declared
rows.limit: a work span the machine promises to cover
rows.source: declare work=(min, max) on the axis, or the travel figure proves nothing about usable area

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 450.0 × 340.0 mm across 4 bodies at z = -0.00 (front_beam, y_beam_far, y_beam_l, y_beam_r)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 4 bodies on the plane, 22 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split
